title: oblivia simplex
intro: Oblivia simplex, commonly known as White Sage or Yerba Santa, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing, reduce stress, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Oblivia simplex include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve coughs and colds, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its various health benefits.
